_comment: Landfall 2026-10-16, the USER's Cultivate case ("the land drop might sometimes want to go after
cultivate, because the lands in hand may not serve your needs as well as the land you get ... They just
don't play it and then play after the breakpoint"). Four untapped Forests; hand Cultivate + Forest +
Lava Spike; opponent at 3; the library's basics are Mountains. The only T6 kill HOLDS the Forest: Cultivate
(three Forests) puts a Mountain onto the battlefield tapped and one into hand, the put-in-hand breakpoint
plays that Mountain untapped, and Lava Spike deals 3. Playing the Forest at any spot spends the drop, the
battlefield Mountain is tapped, and no red is left.
